Unicode IDNA mapping data used by tr46 0.0.3

Source: https://www.unicode.org/Public/idna/8.0.0/IdnaMappingTable.txt
Original data notice: Copyright (c) 1991-2015 Unicode, Inc.
The upstream tr46 generator removes source comments and converts the data to JSON.
The published mappingTable.json exactly matches this transformation of Unicode 8.0.0.

Unicode notice, not a claimed creation date of the 2015 mapping data. Unicode
Terms of Use sections 2(b) and 3(c) cover computer data files under Public/.
